classification.difficultyReason: Find two missing sides using trigonometry, then calculate the perimeter while retaining intermediate precision.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of this triangle, correct to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Right-angled triangle with its 5 m side vertical on the left, horizontal top edge, rising diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, right-angle square at upper-left and 30° label inside the upper-right angle. Ordinary source-blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: The 5 m side is opposite the 30° angle. The horizontal side is adjacent and the diagonal is the hypotenuse. Coordinates preserve the stated 30° angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no calculated side lengths or perimeter appear.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the hypotenuse and $a$ the horizontal side, in metres.
$$\begin{align*}
\sin 30^{\circ} &= \frac{5}{h} \\
h\sin 30^{\circ} &= 5 \\
h &= \frac{5}{\sin 30^{\circ}} \\
h &= 10 \\
\tan 30^{\circ} &= \frac{5}{a} \\
a\tan 30^{\circ} &= 5 \\
a &= \frac{5}{\tan 30^{\circ}} \\
P &= 5+10+\frac{5}{\tan 30^{\circ}} \\
P &\approx 23.7\text{ m}
\end{align*}$$
